sections.heading: 1. Controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is [SELLER LEGAL NAME], a sole proprietor, [ADDRESS]. Contact for privacy questions: [EMAIL].

sections.heading: 2. Data that we process
paragraphs: Account data: your email address, your name, a hash of your password, your interface language.
Technical data: the IP address and the browser data (user agent) of each sign-in session and of the records of the activity log.
Billing data: your plan, your invoices and payments, and the identifiers of your customer and subscription records at the payment provider. We do not receive or store full payment card data.
When you sign in through an external provider (OAuth): your account identifier at that provider, your email address and your name.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: To create your account and to supply the Service and the paid functions: the performance of a contract to which you are party (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)).
To protect accounts and the Service from unauthorized access and abuse, including the activity log and the anti-bot check: our legitimate interests (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)).
To keep the records that tax and accounting law requires: a legal obligation (GDPR Article 6(1)(c)).
We send no marketing mail and we do not use your data for automated decisions that have a legal effect on you.

sections.heading: 4. Recipients
paragraphs: Paddle.com, our reseller and Merchant of Record, which processes orders, payments, taxes and refunds as an independent controller.
Our email delivery provider [NAME], which sends the service messages.
Cloudflare Turnstile, which receives your IP address when the anti-bot check is shown.
The sign-in provider (OAuth) that you select, to the extent necessary for the sign-in.
Our hosting provider [NAME], which stores the data on our behalf.
We do not sell personal data.

sections.heading: 5. Transfers to other countries
paragraphs: Our servers are located in [COUNTRY]. Some recipients process data outside the European Economic Area. Such a transfer rests on an adequacy decision of the European Commission or on the standard contractual clauses of the European Commission. You can ask us for a copy of the safeguards.

sections.heading: 6. Storage periods
paragraphs: We keep account data while your account exists and delete it after you delete the account, unless the law requires a longer storage.
We keep the records of the activity log for [PERIOD] days. We keep billing records for the period that tax and accounting law sets.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict or object to its processing, and to receive it in a portable format.
To use a right, write to [EMAIL]. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of your country.

sections.heading: 8. Whether the data is required
paragraphs: The email address, the name and the password or an external sign-in are a contractual requirement: without them we cannot create an account. Billing data is necessary only when you buy a paid plan or product.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies
paragraphs: The Service uses only the cookies that are necessary for the sign-in and the security of the session. It uses no advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: 10. Changes
paragraphs: We publish a new version of this policy on this page. The date of the version is at the top of the document.
